customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the customer (the business account holder) profile.

company_name.meaning: Registered legal name of the customer company, exactly as on file.

contact_name.meaning: Name of the authorized purchasing or accounts-payable contact on file for the account.

account_number.meaning: Corbett customer account number printed on every invoice and statement, format C-NNNNNN.

phone.meaning: Main phone number registered for the account.

email.meaning: Accounts-payable or purchasing email address registered for the account.

ein_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the customer's federal Employer Identification Number on file.

billing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the customer's bill-to address.

customer_since.meaning: Date the customer profile was opened at Corbett.

industry_segment.meaning: Industry segment Corbett assigned to the customer at onboarding.

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the identity verification record (one per customer).

customer_id.meaning: Customer whose caller was verified (foreign key -> customers).

verified.meaning: Whether the caller passed verification; once true it never reverts to false.

verified_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the handoff record.

customer_id.meaning: Customer handed to a human representative (foreign key -> customers).

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()

credit_account_id.meaning: Primary id of the Commercial Credit Account.

variant_name.meaning: Terms tier held, written as the official full tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the credit account (see the credit charter lifecycle).

opened_date.meaning: Date the account was approved and opened; empty while applied.

closed_date.meaning: Date the account was closed or the application declined; empty while open.

credit_limit.meaning: Current credit limit including any unexpired temporary increase.

ar_balance.meaning: Open receivable balance: identically the sum of the receivable account deltas (invoices and charges positive; payments, discounts, credits and write-offs negative); negative means a credit balance.

invoice_delivery.meaning: Channel by which invoices are delivered.

billing_cycle.meaning: Whether each shipment or service is invoiced separately or a calendar month is consolidated on one invoice.

hold_reason.meaning: Why the account is on hold or in collections; none while active.

last_review_date.meaning: Date of the account's most recent credit review (approval, limit decision, tier change or reinstatement).

close_reason.meaning: Why the account closed or was declined; none while open.

credit_txn_id.meaning: Primary id of the receivable ledger line.

credit_account_id.meaning: Credit account the line posts to (foreign key -> credit_accounts).

event_type.meaning: Ledger event family, verbatim from the credit charter.

document_number.meaning: Number of the document posted: invoice INV-..., credit memo CM-..., payment reference, bank return reference, charge reference, refund or write-off reference.

txn_date.meaning: Document date: invoice date, payment received date, memo date, charge date.

due_date.meaning: Due date of an invoice or charge; empty for payments, credits and adjustments.

amount.meaning: Absolute amount of the line; its effect on the balance follows the event family's direction (invoices, charges, returned payments and refunds raise it; payments, discounts, credits and write-offs lower it).

merchandise_amount.meaning: Merchandise or service subtotal of an invoice; 0.00 on other lines.

freight_amount.meaning: Freight billed on an invoice; 0.00 on other lines.

tax_amount.meaning: Sales tax billed on an invoice; 0.00 on other lines.

source_type.meaning: What business record produced the line (for credit memos, the reason class of the credit).

source_reference.meaning: Reference of the source business record: order number, RMA number, claim or dispute reference, rebate period reference, service or visit reference, original payment reference, or charge month reference.

applied_invoice_number.meaning: Invoice number a payment, discount, returned payment, credit memo or write-off applies to; ON-ACCOUNT for an unapplied credit; empty on invoices and charges.

payment_method.meaning: Payment or refund method; none on lines that are not payments or refunds.

charge_type.meaning: Kind of account charge; none on lines that are not charges.

billing_period.meaning: Billing month a charge belongs to; empty on lines that are not charges.

credit_dispute_id.meaning: Primary id of the dispute record line.

credit_account_id.meaning: Credit account of the disputed invoice (foreign key -> credit_accounts).

event_type.meaning: Dispute event family, verbatim from the credit charter.

dispute_reference.meaning: Dispute reference DSP-NNNNNN shared by the opening and the resolution line of one dispute.

disputed_amount.meaning: Amount the records show was overbilled on the opening line; amount credited on a credited resolution line.

event_date.meaning: Date the dispute was opened or resolved.

resolution.meaning: Outcome; pending on the opening line.

credit_review_id.meaning: Primary id of the limit review line.

event_type.meaning: Limit review event family, verbatim from the credit charter.

review_reference.meaning: Limit review reference CLR-NNNNNN shared by the request and decision lines.

request_date.meaning: Date of the request on the request line; date of the decision on the decision line.

requested_limit.meaning: Credit limit the customer asked for.

change_type.meaning: Whether a permanent or a temporary increase is requested.

decision.meaning: Decision; pending on the request line.

approved_limit.meaning: Limit granted; 0.00 when pending, declined or referred.

expiry_date.meaning: Last day of a temporary increase; empty for permanent decisions and requests.

pricing_agreement_id.meaning: Primary id of the Contract Pricing Agreement.

variant_name.meaning: Agreement tier, written as the official full tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the agreement (see the pricing charter lifecycle).

agreement_number.meaning: Agreement number printed on the signed contract, format CPA-NNNNN.

effective_date.meaning: First day of the current term; empty while proposed.

expiration_date.meaning: Last day of the current term; empty while proposed.

closed_date.meaning: Date the agreement lapsed, expired or terminated; empty while live.

annual_spend_commitment.meaning: Annual net merchandise spend committed under the current tier.

rebate_balance.meaning: Unpaid volume rebate: identically the sum of the rebate account deltas (accruals positive; payouts, clawbacks and forfeitures negative).

termination_notice_date.meaning: Date the customer's written early termination notice was received; empty when none.

auto_renew.meaning: Whether the agreement renews automatically at the end of the term.

contract_item_id.meaning: Primary id of the contract item price line.

pricing_agreement_id.meaning: Agreement the price line belongs to (foreign key -> pricing_agreements).

event_type.meaning: Contract item event family, verbatim from the pricing charter.

sku.meaning: Corbett item number, format two letters and five digits (e.g. FS-20431).

product_category.meaning: Corbett product category of the item.

list_price.meaning: Corbett list unit price on the effective date.

supplier_cost.meaning: Corbett's supplier unit cost on the effective date.

contract_unit_price.meaning: Contract unit price taking effect (for a removal, the price that ends).

prior_unit_price.meaning: Unit price in effect immediately before this line.

competitor_unit_price.meaning: Competitor's written quoted unit price for a competitive match; 0.0000 on other lines.

quote_date.meaning: Date of the Corbett special pricing quote (item added) or of the competitor's written quote (competitive match); empty otherwise.

notice_date.meaning: Date the escalation, supplier cost change or removal notice was sent; empty otherwise.

effective_date.meaning: First ship date on which the line applies.

change_reason.meaning: Why the price line was written.

change_reference.meaning: Quote or change reference (SPQ-NNNNNN for quotes, PCH-NNNNNN for changes).

price_claim_id.meaning: Primary id of the price claim line.

pricing_agreement_id.meaning: Agreement whose price is claimed (foreign key -> pricing_agreements).

event_type.meaning: Price claim event family, verbatim from the pricing charter.

claim_reference.meaning: Claim reference PCL-NNNNNN shared by the filing and decision lines.

invoice_number.meaning: Invoice number of the billed line (INV-...).

sku.meaning: Corbett item number of the billed line.

quantity.meaning: Quantity billed on the invoice line.

billed_unit_price.meaning: Unit price billed on the invoice line.

contract_unit_price.meaning: Unit price the agreement sets for the line's ship date.

claim_amount.meaning: Overbilling computed on the filing line; amount credited on an approved decision line, 0.00 on other decisions.

outcome.meaning: Claim outcome; pending on the filing line.

rebate_line_id.meaning: Primary id of the rebate ledger line.

pricing_agreement_id.meaning: Agreement earning the rebate (foreign key -> pricing_agreements).

event_type.meaning: Rebate event family, verbatim from the pricing charter.

rebate_period.meaning: Rebate period the line belongs to.

qualifying_spend.meaning: Qualifying spend measured for an accrual; negative returned merchandise value for a clawback; 0.00 on payouts and forfeitures.

rebate_rate_pct.meaning: Ladder rate applied; 0.00 on payouts and forfeitures.

amount.meaning: Rebate accrued, paid or reversed; direction follows the event family.

payout_method.meaning: Payout method of a payout line; none on accruals and reversals.

source_reference.meaning: Period reference for an accrual, payout reference for a payout, RMA number for a clawback, agreement number for a forfeiture.

ship_to_id.meaning: Primary id of the Ship-To Fulfillment Account (one delivery location).

variant_name.meaning: Service level of the ship-to, written as the official full tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the ship-to (see the order charter lifecycle).

ship_to_number.meaning: Ship-to number printed on packing lists, format ST-NNNNN.

site_name.meaning: Site name of the delivery location as the customer gives it (e.g. 'Plant 2 Maintenance Crib').

ship_to_zip.meaning: Delivery ZIP code of the location.

opened_date.meaning: Date the ship-to opened; empty while pending_setup.

closed_date.meaning: Date the ship-to closed; empty while open.

last_order_date.meaning: Booking date of the most recent order on the ship-to; empty when none.

last_review_date.meaning: Date of the most recent service level change or review; empty when none.

open_backorder_value.meaning: Open backorder value at booked price: identically the sum of the backorder account deltas.

order_line_id.meaning: Primary id of the order ledger line.

ship_to_id.meaning: Ship-to of the order (foreign key -> ship_to_accounts).

event_type.meaning: Order event family, verbatim from the order charter.

line_number.meaning: Line number on the sales order; 0 for order-level fees.

shipment_number.meaning: Packing list number of a shipment, format PL-NNNNNNN; NONE on lines not tied to a shipment; empty on bookings, backorders and cancellations.

backorder_reference.meaning: Backorder reference BO-NNNNNN on backorder, fill and backorder cancellation lines; empty otherwise.

sku.meaning: Corbett item number of the line; empty on fees.

product_category.meaning: Product category of the item; none on fees.

item_class.meaning: Item handling class; none on fees.

stock_status.meaning: Whether the item is stocked or a non-stock special order; none on fees.

quantity.meaning: Quantity booked, shipped, backordered or cancelled; 0 on fees.

unit_price.meaning: Unit price of the line (booked price on bookings, backorders and cancellations; ship-date price on shipments).

extended_amount.meaning: Quantity times unit price rounded to the cent; the fee amount on fee lines; on a backorder fill, the booked-price value relieved from the backorder.

ship_method.meaning: Ship method requested or used; none where not applicable.

booked_at.meaning: Booking timestamp of the line; carried on bookings and line cancellations, empty otherwise.

event_date.meaning: Date of the event: booking, ship, backorder, cancellation or fee date.

delivered_date.meaning: Date a shipment was delivered; empty until delivered and on non-shipment lines.

promise_date.meaning: Expected fill date given for a backorder; empty otherwise.

customer_po.meaning: Customer purchase order number quoted on the order.

cancel_source.meaning: Who cancelled a line or backorder; none on other lines.

fee_type.meaning: Kind of fee on a fee line; none on other lines.

return_line_id.meaning: Primary id of the return ledger line.

ship_to_id.meaning: Ship-to the goods were shipped to (foreign key -> ship_to_accounts).

event_type.meaning: Return event family, verbatim from the order charter.

rma_number.meaning: Return material authorization number, format RMA-NNNNNN.

order_number.meaning: Sales order of the shipped line being returned.

line_number.meaning: Line number of the shipped line being returned.

item_class.meaning: Item handling class of the returned item.

stock_status.meaning: Whether the returned item was stocked or a special order.

quantity.meaning: Quantity requested, authorized, received or closed.

unit_price.meaning: Invoiced unit price of the shipped line.

return_reason.meaning: Reason class of the return; the first two are customer reasons, the rest Corbett-error reasons.

return_method.meaning: How the goods come back; none on non-authorization lines.

decline_reason.meaning: Why a request was declined; none on other lines.

item_condition.meaning: Condition found at inspection; none before receipt.

close_reason.meaning: Why an RMA line closed without credit; none on other lines.

restocking_fee.meaning: Restocking fee deducted on receipt; 0.00 otherwise.

label_fee.meaning: Return label fee deducted on receipt; 0.00 otherwise.

event_date.meaning: RMA, decline, receipt or closing date.

vmi_program_id.meaning: Primary id of the StockSmart program.

ship_to_id.meaning: Ship-to whose storeroom or point of use the program serves (foreign key -> ship_to_accounts).

variant_name.meaning: Program tier, written as the official full tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the program (see the vmi charter lifecycle).

program_number.meaning: Program number printed on visit reports, format VMI-NNNNN.

go_live_date.meaning: Go-live date, start of the minimum term; empty while enrolled.

termination_notice_date.meaning: Date the customer's written termination notice was received; empty when none.

pause_start_date.meaning: First day of the current or most recent pause; empty when never paused.

pause_end_date.meaning: Last paused day planned or taken; empty for an open credit hold pause or when never paused.

pause_reason.meaning: Reason for the current pause; none when not paused.

consigned_stock_value.meaning: Consigned stock in the bins at contract price: identically the sum of the consigned_stock account deltas.

vmi_activity_id.meaning: Primary id of the program activity line.

event_type.meaning: Program activity event family, verbatim from the vmi charter.

activity_reference.meaning: Reference of the visit (VV-...), self-scan order (VSO-...), cycle count (VCC-...), withdrawal (VWD-...), pause (VPA-...), buyback (VBB-...) or fee request; the billing month YYYY-MM for monthly fees.

visit_type.meaning: Kind of visit on a visit line; none elsewhere.

bin_label.meaning: Bin label (e.g. A-03-12) on bin-level lines; empty elsewhere.

sku.meaning: Corbett item number on item-level lines; empty elsewhere.

quantity.meaning: Units delivered, stocked, issued, short, withdrawn or bought back; the count a fee is computed on; 0 where not applicable.

unit_price.meaning: Billing unit price on item-level lines; 0.0000 elsewhere.

extended_amount.meaning: Line value: quantity times unit price, a billed total, or a fee amount.

freight_amount.meaning: Freight billed with a replenishment billing line; 0.00 elsewhere.

critical_item.meaning: Whether a replenished bin is flagged critical; false on non-bin lines.

billing_period.meaning: Billing month of consumption, shrink and fee lines; empty elsewhere.

fee_type.meaning: Kind of program fee on a fee line; none elsewhere.

pause_start_date.meaning: First paused day on a pause line; empty elsewhere.

pause_end_date.meaning: Last planned paused day on a pause line; empty for a credit hold pause and elsewhere.

pause_reason.meaning: Reason on a pause line; none elsewhere.

vmi_bin_id.meaning: Primary id of the bin change line.

event_type.meaning: Bin event family, verbatim from the vmi charter.

sku.meaning: Corbett item number stocked in the bin.

special_stock.meaning: Whether the item is non-catalog special stock held for the program.

critical_item.meaning: Whether the bin is flagged critical at the customer's written request.

consigned.meaning: Whether the bin holds Corbett-owned consigned stock.

min_qty.meaning: Reorder point of the bin; 0 on removal lines.

max_qty.meaning: Fill-to level of the bin; 0 on removal lines.

removal_reason.meaning: Why a bin was removed; none on other lines.

change_reference.meaning: Customer request or review reference for the change (VBR-NNNNNN).

vending_machine_id.meaning: Primary id of the VendPoint machine placement.

ship_to_id.meaning: Ship-to where the machine stands (foreign key -> ship_to_accounts).

variant_name.meaning: Machine model tier, written as the official full tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the machine placement (see the vending charter lifecycle).

machine_serial.meaning: Serial number on the machine's front plate, format VP-NNNNNN; empty until installed.

installed_date.meaning: Installation date, start of the minimum term; empty until installed.

removed_date.meaning: Removal or cancellation date; empty while placed.

locked_date.meaning: Date the machine was locked under a credit hold; empty when not locked.

termination_notice_date.meaning: Date the customer's written removal notice was received; empty when none.

network_connection.meaning: How the machine reports to Corbett (cellular when the site provides no network drop).

machine_stock_value.meaning: Consigned stock loaded in the machine at contract price: identically the sum of the machine_stock account deltas.

vending_txn_id.meaning: Primary id of the machine transaction line.

ship_to_id.meaning: Ship-to the machine moved to, on relocation lines; empty elsewhere (foreign key -> ship_to_accounts).

event_type.meaning: Machine transaction event family, verbatim from the vending charter.

txn_reference.meaning: Reference of the line: vend VT-..., return VR-..., error credit VE-..., restock VRS-..., count VCN-..., withdrawal VWS-..., relocation VRL-..., fee work order; the billing month YYYY-MM for monthly bills and fees.

original_txn_reference.meaning: Vend transaction a return or vend error credit refers to; empty elsewhere.

sku.meaning: Corbett item number on item lines; empty elsewhere.

product_category.meaning: Product category on item lines; none elsewhere.

quantity.meaning: Units vended, returned, credited, loaded, short or withdrawn; the count a fee is computed on; 0 where not applicable.

unit_price.meaning: Unit price on item lines; 0.0000 elsewhere.

extended_amount.meaning: Line value: quantity times unit price, a billed net total, or a fee amount.

employee_badge.meaning: Employee badge number on vend and return lines; empty elsewhere.

cost_center.meaning: Customer cost center code on vend, return, error and usage bill lines (ALL on a bill that is not split); empty elsewhere.

vended_at.meaning: Vend timestamp from the machine log on vend lines; empty elsewhere.

visit_type.meaning: Kind of restock visit on restock lines; none elsewhere.

billing_period.meaning: Billing month of bill, shrink and fee lines; empty elsewhere.

fee_type.meaning: Kind of fee on fee lines; none elsewhere.

vending_slot_id.meaning: Primary id of the selection change line.

event_type.meaning: Planogram event family, verbatim from the vending charter.

slot_label.meaning: Selection label (door, coil or bay), e.g. D07 or C-14.

sku.meaning: Corbett item number assigned to or removed from the selection.

par_qty.meaning: Par quantity of the selection; 0 on removal lines.

special_item.meaning: Whether the item is a non-catalog special item.

change_source.meaning: Who asked for the change (only customer changes count toward the included changes).

removal_reason.meaning: Why a selection was removed; none on other lines.

calibration_plan_id.meaning: Primary id of the CalCare plan.

variant_name.meaning: Plan tier, written as the official full tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the plan (see the calibration charter lifecycle).

plan_number.meaning: Plan number printed on certificates and invoices, format CAL-NNNNN.

plan_year_start.meaning: First day of the current plan year; empty while pending.

plan_year_end.meaning: Last day of the current plan year; empty while pending.

closed_date.meaning: Date the plan lapsed or the cancellation took effect; empty while live.

cancellation_notice_date.meaning: Date the written cancellation notice was received; empty when none.

prepaid_units_balance.meaning: Prepaid units available: identically the sum of the prepaid_units account deltas.

calibration_asset_id.meaning: Primary id of the instrument registry line.

event_type.meaning: Registry event family, verbatim from the calibration charter.

asset_tag.meaning: Customer's asset tag on the instrument.

instrument_class.meaning: Instrument class; none on retirement lines.

manufacturer_model.meaning: Manufacturer and model as on the instrument nameplate; empty on retirement lines.

retire_reason.meaning: Why the instrument was retired; none on registration lines.

cal_service_id.meaning: Primary id of the calibration service line.

event_type.meaning: Service event family, verbatim from the calibration charter.

service_reference.meaning: Work order CWO-..., repair quote CRQ-..., plan year CPY-..., top-up CTU-... or billing reference.

asset_tag.meaning: Instrument the line concerns; empty on plan-level lines.

certificate_type.meaning: Certificate issued on a calibration line; none elsewhere.

as_found_result.meaning: As-found result on a calibration line; none elsewhere.

units.meaning: Units granted, bought, expired or consumed, or the units a charge is computed on; 0 where not applicable.

amount.meaning: Charge, credit, top-up price or quoted repair price; 0.00 where not applicable.

rush.meaning: Whether rush turnaround was ordered on a calibration line; false elsewhere.

quote_decision.meaning: Customer decision on a repair quote decision line; none elsewhere.

charge_type.meaning: Kind of charge or credit on billing and credit lines; none elsewhere.

safety_program_id.meaning: Primary id of the SafeStep program.

variant_name.meaning: Program tier, written as the official full tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the program (see the safety charter lifecycle).

program_number.meaning: Program number printed on vouchers, format SS-NNNNN.

go_live_date.meaning: Go-live date, start of the minimum term; empty while enrolled.

allowance_year_start.meaning: First day of the current allowance year; empty while enrolled.

suspended_date.meaning: Date redemptions were suspended under a credit hold; empty when not suspended.

termination_notice_date.meaning: Date the written termination notice was received; empty when none.

allowance_pool_balance.meaning: Unredeemed allowance across all participants: identically the sum of the allowance account deltas.

safety_participant_id.meaning: Primary id of the roster line.

event_type.meaning: Roster event family, verbatim from the safety charter.

employee_number.meaning: Customer's employee number for the participant.

employee_name.meaning: Participant name as on the customer's roster; empty on removal lines.

job_class.meaning: Job class that sets the footwear rating; none on removal lines.

hire_date.meaning: Employee's hire date as stated by the program administrator; empty on removal lines.

removal_reason.meaning: Why removed; none on addition lines.

safety_redemption_id.meaning: Primary id of the allowance ledger line.

event_type.meaning: Allowance event family, verbatim from the safety charter.

redemption_reference.meaning: Redemption SR-..., return SRR-... or billed redemption reference; the billing month for a consolidated bill; empty on grants, expiries and fees.

original_redemption_reference.meaning: Redemption a return refers to; empty elsewhere.

employee_number.meaning: Participant's employee number; empty on bills and fees.

product_type.meaning: Allowance product type; none on bills and fees.

allowance_year.format: YYYY-MM-DD (first day of the allowance year)
allowance_year.meaning: Allowance year the line belongs to; empty on bills and fees.

retail_amount.meaning: Retail price on redemption lines; 0.00 elsewhere.

employer_amount.meaning: Employer-funded amount: allowance granted, redeemed, restored or expired, amount billed, or fee.

employee_amount.meaning: Employee-paid portion on redemption lines; 0.00 elsewhere.

channel.meaning: Where a redemption was made; none elsewhere.

billing_period.meaning: Billing month on bill and fee lines; empty elsewhere.

fee_type.meaning: Kind of fee on fee lines; none elsewhere.

fee_reference.meaning: Visit, online order, allowance year or termination reference on fee lines; empty elsewhere.
